title: Lear tips KLAS about F-117

tellings.quote: He had told my boss, Ned Day, managing editor, about this amazing plane that was invisible to radar flying up at Tonopah and Area 51.

plain: In 1987 a pilot named John Lear told Ned Day, managing editor at the Las Vegas TV station KLAS, about "this amazing plane that was invisible to radar" flying at Tonopah and Area 51, two secret test sites in the Nevada desert. That plane was the F-117, a stealth attack jet the Air Force was still keeping secret. George Knapp, a Las Vegas TV journalist who worked under Day, tells this as something his boss was told, and it suggests Lear really did know about hidden aircraft before the public did.
